title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a pair address reads the package it names: its envelope is that package's, and an App pair two of whose modules hold the name is refused naming both (ADR-0150 D5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuBdS96DD1Rta7hrLt6bkwBb)_
domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXYPmTrQ4KGuKWzNh7

Fixes #32501

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — the App pair address `APP.custom`, when two enabled modules of the App hold the name and one of them is the first registered package that ships it, is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both modules where it answered with the first registered module's item, on every door that reads it: `GET /meta/TYPE/NAME?package=APP.custom` and its `/layers`, `GET /meta/dataset/NAME?callerPackage=APP.custom` naming a pair the registry does not hold (which reads as `?package=`), and the qualified path `GET /meta/TYPE/APPNS_custom/NAME` (the installed pair's namespace), on both transports; the dataset query doors `POST /analytics/dataset/query` and `/batch` with `?package=APP.custom`, or `?callerPackage=APP.custom` naming a pair the registry does not hold, under an analytics service without plugin-wired admission or for a caller admitted to both modules' datasets (nothing is run); the import doors' qualified `mappingName` `APPNS_custom/NAME` (nothing is written); and the publish probes' dataset read for a publish of an App pair the registry does not hold. On the dataset doors under plugin-wired admission the refusal is judged over the modules the caller is admitted to, the #32292 admission narrowing carried over (seat ruling 6817809380), in either registration order: admitted to one module's dataset only, that dataset runs where the first registered module's dataset reached the query's own gates (`200` with it run when it was that module's, else `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`); admitted to neither, the answer is what a name nothing holds gets, `404 NOT_FOUND` byte for byte, where it was that `403`. `/layers` at an App pair that holds a stored row of a name two of its modules ship, when one of those modules is the first registered package that ships the name, is refused the same way where it reported that module's body as the code layer. With another package registered ahead of the modules, every one of these already answered the 409. The other moved answers keep their status and name the package the address reads in place of the first registered holder: the envelope (`_packageId`, `_packageVersion`, `_provenance`) of a base's pair address and of a stored row read at an exact address. Three widen from 404 to 200: on the same doors, the pair of an enabled base and an App pair one of whose two module holders is disabled, when the disabled holder registered first; on `?package=` and its `/layers`, a row of a package that ships nothing, its only shipper disabled.
Metadata-protocol: none — no key, value or metadata type an author writes changes; what moves is which package an exact read's answer names, and when it refuses.
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no read at a customization pair address of a name two packages hold; the prescription ships in the refusal text and the before → after list in the changeset.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按配对地址读取元数据时（`?package=基包.custom`，或配对包命名空间的限定路径 `基包命名空间_custom/名字`），返回体的 `_packageId` / `_packageVersion` / `_provenance` 取自地址实际读的那个包，不再取最先注册的持有者；App 的两个模块都持有同名项、且其中一个是最先注册的提供者时，App 配对地址返回 409 点名两个模块，不再挑先注册的那个。读这个地址的门一起变：`/meta` 普通读与 `/layers`、`/meta` 限定路径、dataset 查询单门与 batch 门、导入门的限定 `mappingName`，以及发布探针读未注册配对包的 dataset。dataset 两个门在插件准入下沿用 #32292 / 6817809380 的准入收窄：调用方对两个模块都有准入时答 409 点名两个；只对一个有准入就执行那一个，另一个不点名；都没有准入答 404，和名字不存在时逐字节一样（main 上这三种都是先注册模块的 dataset 进到查询自己的门禁：有准入 200，没有 403）。
- 为什么：专题红线 2（歧义要报告、不许猜）。以前两个包持有同名项时，后注册那个包的配对地址答自己的内容却标成先注册包的；先注册的包被停用时，启用包的配对地址甚至答 404。
- 风险与回滚：第一方 0 处（要求两个命名空间持有同名项）。收窄只发生在 App 两个模块同持一名、且有一个模块先于其他提供者注册的配对地址，真实引擎和裸 `SchemaRegistry` 一样；另有包先注册时本来就答 409。三处 404 → 200 是放宽；插件准入下只对后注册模块有准入的调用方从 403 变成 200（执行它有准入的那个），也是放宽。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-bindings.ts` 的 `exactAddressArtifact`；`protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` 的 `readMetaItem` 信封查找；`protocol-exact-qualifier.ts` 的 `exactQualifierItem` 早返回那一行（两个基包时落到点名拒绝）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-legacy-pair-served.test.ts -t 32501`，预期 13 例全过（main 上 10 例红，剩下 3 例是注册顺序对照）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Branch head `6ff8d6912`, the landing head: one merge of `main` 386891ebc (`7e51f8282`), then the dataset doors pinned under plugin-wired admission and the changeset restated for them (contract review delta round 6837692940, merge notes A and B). Round 2 (contract review r1, 6836136864) added tests and prose only on top of `1d8ea4ad7`; no source line moves since `1d8ea4ad7`. The diff against `main` 386891ebc is 11 files, +802 / −23.

Measured on `main` against this head, per answer: 2f80f2897 for rounds 1 and 2, and 386891ebc (with #32804) for rows D2 to D2d, which the landing merge moved. What decides the FROM of the App-pair refusal is the registration shape, not the composition: on the real ObjectQL engine with an SQL store and on the bare `SchemaRegistry` composition alike, the App pair whose two modules are the only shippers of the name (so a module is the first registered one) answered 200 with the first registered module's item, and with another package registered ahead of the modules it already answered 409.

| # | state | door | FROM (`main` 2f80f2897) | TO (this head) | arm |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| L2 | two enabled modules M1, M2 of App P hold NAME, a module the first registered shipper (either module order), no stored row; both compositions | `GET /meta/TYPE/NAME?package=P.custom` and its `/layers`; for a dataset, `GET /meta/dataset/NAME?callerPackage=P.custom` naming a pair the registry does not hold (it reads as `?package=`); the qualified path `GET /meta/TYPE/PNS_custom/NAME` (pair installed) | 200, the first registered module's item | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming M1 and M2 | narrowing |
| L2′ | the same, another package registered ahead of the modules | the same doors | 409 (already) | 409 | none |
| D2 | the same as L2, for a dataset; an analytics service without plugin-wired admission (built by hand, its gates inactive) | `POST /analytics/dataset/query?package=P.custom` and the same query in `/batch`; `?callerPackage=P.custom` naming a pair the registry does not hold; the pair installed or not for `?package=` | 200, the first registered module's dataset run | 409 naming M1 and M2, nothing run (`/batch`: that query's entry) | narrowing |
| D2a | the same, plugin-wired admission, the caller admitted to both modules' datasets; the #32292 admission narrowing (seat ruling 6817809380) carried over | the same doors and spellings | 200, the first registered module's dataset run (admission not asked) | 409 naming M1 and M2, nothing run | narrowing |
| D2b | the same, admitted to the first registered module's dataset only | the same | 200, that dataset run | the same | none |
| D2c | the same, admitted to the other module's dataset only | the same | `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`: the first registered module's dataset reached the query's own gates | 200, the admitted module's dataset run; the other module never named | widening |
| D2d | the same, admitted to neither | the same | `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` (the same) | `404 NOT_FOUND`, byte for byte the answer for a name nothing holds; neither module named, nothing run | refusal to refusal |
| D2′ | the same, the pair installed | `?callerPackage=P.custom` | the caller arm's refusal: 409 naming both without plugin-wired admission; with it, already judged as D2a to D2d's TO (#32292) | the same | none |
| I2 | the same as L2, for a mapping, the pair installed | `POST /data/OBJECT/import` with `mappingName: PNS_custom/NAME` | 200, rows imported through the first registered module's mapping | 409 naming M1 and M2, nothing written | narrowing |
| B2 | the same as L2, for a dataset | the publish probes' dataset read, publishing package P.custom not registered | the first registered module's dataset probed | refused naming M1 and M2 (the widget is reported not probed) | narrowing |
| B2′ | the same, P.custom registered | the publish probes' dataset read | refused (already: the caller arm) | the same | none |
| L2r | App pair `P.custom` holds a stored row; M1, M2 ship NAME, a module the first registered shipper (real engine) | `/layers?package=P.custom` | 200, that module's body as `code` | 409 naming M1 and M2 | narrowing |
| L2r′ | the same, another package registered ahead of the modules | `/layers?package=P.custom` | 409 (already: #32497 judges the code layer through `exactQualifierItem`) | 409 | none |
| L1 | A and B enabled hold NAME, B registered first | `?package=A.custom`; the qualified path at `ANS_custom` | 200 A's body under B's `_packageId` | 200 A's body under A's | moved answer |
| L1′ | the same | `/layers?package=A.custom`; the dataset and import doors | A's code layer, A's dataset run, A's mapping imported (already) | the same | none |
| L1d | B disabled and registered first | `?package=A.custom` and its `/layers`; the qualified path; the dataset doors; the import door at `ANS_custom`; the publish probes for an unregistered A.custom | 404 (import: `404 MAPPING_NOT_FOUND`; probes: nothing found) | 200 A's item, run, imported, probed | widening |
| L2d | M2 disabled and registered first | the same doors at `P.custom` / `PNS_custom` | 404 (the same spellings) | 200 M1's item, run, imported, probed | widening |
| L1d-i / L2d-i | the import door alone, at the pair namespace of L1d and L2d (B or M2 disabled and registered first) | `POST /data/OBJECT/import` with `mappingName: ANS_custom/NAME` or `PNS_custom/NAME` | `404 MAPPING_NOT_FOUND`, nothing written | 200, rows written through A's (or M1's) mapping | widening (listed on its own per the epic delta read 6839753325; pinned by the two import pins; the changeset row rides #32874) |
| R1 | A's pair override row at `A.custom`, B registered first | `?package=A.custom` | the row under B's `_packageId`, `_packageVersion`, `_provenance` | under A's | moved answer |
| R2 | a row bound only to G, which ships nothing; either shipper order | `?package=G` | the row under the first registered shipper's envelope (`_provenance: package`) | its own stamp (`_packageId: G`), no artifact envelope | moved answer |
| R2′ | the same | `/layers?package=G` | `code: null` (already) | the same | none |
| R3 | the row bound to G, its only shipper disabled | `?package=G` and its `/layers` | 404 (withheld by the disabled shipper's grafted stamp) | 200, the row under its own stamp | widening |
| R4 | the App pair's own row, two modules ship NAME, any order | `?package=P.custom` | the row under the first registered shipper's envelope | its own stamp (`P.custom`) | moved answer |

Rows D2a to D2d hold in either module order, on the single door and the `/batch` entry, for `?package=P.custom` (the pair installed or not) and `?callerPackage=P.custom` naming a pair the registry does not hold. They are measured over a double whose admission admits by the dataset's object and whose query refuses an object the caller is not admitted to with `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403, as the real service's gates do; the FROM column is that double on `main` 386891ebc, the TO column on this head. The epic seat ruled that running the one admitted module (D2c) is the #32292 admission narrowing, not a pick under red line 2, so it is declared as measured. On the widened rows L1d and L2d a dataset the address now resolves meets the query's own gates: under plugin-wired admission a caller admitted to it gets it run, any other caller its `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` (measured at this head by a probe; a name the read resolves keeps its answer under #32292). `GET /meta/dataset/NAME?callerPackage=P.custom` naming a pair the registry does not hold was measured by the contract review's delta round (probe 6) at `9fb9034c0`, whose source this head keeps: 409 naming both, both orders; with the pair installed the caller arm already refused.

The other readers of the exact read, swept: the import job door `POST /data/OBJECT/import/jobs` parses through the same `prepareImportRequest` and mapping read as the sync door (read, not run); `/meta`'s other sub-resources take no `?package=` GET (the contract review's probe 2); the publish probes read a registered publishing package's dataset through the caller arm, which resolves to the holder's own address (unchanged) or refuses (unchanged), so only an unregistered publishing package moves; the permission save door's held-grants read is refused before it at the App pair, identically on both sides (the contract review's probe 3). The list scoped to an exact address does not move (follow-up card, below).

**The fix** (three source hunks, unchanged since the card's development round):

1. **F1, the strict envelope** (`protocol-package-bindings.ts` `exactAddressArtifact`, called from `readMetaItem`). At an admitted exact address the artifact envelope is looked up at the one package the address reads (the named package when it holds the name, else its one admitted base) and kept only when it is that package's own (`_packageId` equal to it). Two admitted bases, or none, leave the body its own stamp. Before, the lookup asked at the pair id, which ships nothing, so `getArtifactItem`'s any-composite tier answered the first registered package that ships the name.
2. **F2, two admitted bases** (`protocol-exact-qualifier.ts` `exactQualifierItem`, one line). An item of one of TWO admitted bases (two modules of one App sharing its pair) no longer returns early; it falls through to the refusal naming both. Every door above shares this judge.
3. **F3 is no longer this card's.** The round-1 hunk that sent the `/layers` code layer through `exactQualifierItem` is on `main` already: #32497 carries the same call (its #32407 lines), so the merge took `main`'s file and this card no longer edits `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`.

Compositions: the transport pins (`packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`) and the dataset door pins (`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts`) drive the real protocol over a real `SchemaRegistry`; the stored-row and no-row App pair pins (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-legacy-pair-served.test.ts`) and the import pins (`packages/rest/src/import-integration.test.ts`) drive the real ObjectQL engine with an SQL store. The stored rows are inserted straight into `sys_metadata`; the contract review measured the hydrated rows answering the same.

## Merges with main

#32497 landed squashed as `0763bf6ec`. Its tree delta is byte-identical to `776474e8b..28b37fbb7` (the blocker's landed head): same 53 files, same `git patch-id --stable`. So the branch takes that head first and `main` second, both as merges, no rebase:

- `6e575e3a` merges `28b37fbb7`. Conflicts, each resolved to the blocker's side for what #32497 owns: `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` (taken whole; see F3), and the REST and runtime test files where both sides appended a top-level `describe` at the same spot (both kept, the blocker's first).
- `040e2d62` merges `main` 2f80f2897. The only conflicts were three hunks where this card edits lines #32497 added (the #32501 location 1 pin flips below); each is the branch's side, which is `main`'s text plus the flip.
- `git show --remerge-diff` of each merge touches only this card's files: `6e575e3a` → `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`, the REST and runtime `meta-qualified-item-*` tests; `040e2d62` → `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` and the same two tests.
- `1d8ea4ad` re-measures on `main` 2f80f2897: the changeset drops the two `/layers` moves #32497 already made and narrows the App-pair-row `/layers` claim to the module-first shape; the three widening pins assert `/layers` beside the plain read; the stored-row App pair pin gains the two module-first cases.
- Round 2, on the contract review r1 (6836136864): `667c39373` pins the dataset single and batch doors, the publish probes' dataset read, the import door's qualified `mappingName` with `GET /meta`'s qualified path at a pair namespace, and the no-row App pair on the real engine (S1); `0f9681d21` rewrites the changeset's declaration by registration shape and names every door (B1, B2, N4), and pins the publish probes' widenings; `9fb9034c0` adds the dispatcher's qualified path at the installed pair's namespace to the no-row pins.
- The landing merge, on the delta round 6837692940: `7e51f8282` merges `main` 386891ebc (the PR went dirty after #32804). One conflict, `packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts`: both sides appended a top-level `describe` at the end of the file (this card's pair-address dataset doors, #32292's refusal-arm admission); both kept, this card's first (merge note A). `git show --remerge-diff 7e51f8282` touches only that file (+3 / −3, the conflict's closing lines), and the diff against `main` was the same 11 files, +721 / −23, as before the merge. `a26140d22` pins the dataset doors under plugin-wired admission (merge note B; rows D2a to D2d, D2′); `72c4f9b18` and `6ff8d6912` restate the changeset's dataset clause, its BREAKING bullet and its widenings per admission case, and fix N5 and N6.

## Accepted deviation: pins of #32183 flipped

Epic note 6820163174 asks this card to flip #32183's pins of location 1 when it lands:

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` (`e9e2227e`): `?package=ENABLED.custom` beside a package-less row with the other holder disabled was pinned 404 when the disabled holder registered first; it is the row in both orders now.

## Verification

No source line moves from `1d8ea4ad7`. Per the epic's economy rule (Sales, revised 11-12, on the epic #31527 card page), after the landing merge only the gates the merge and the landing commits affect rerun (AGENTS.md multi-agent discipline §10), and the full dogfood battery runs once, on the landing head, this being a narrowing arm.
